subject.title: [Feature Request] 支持PostgreSQL替代SQLite作为内部存储

question: Should OpenClaw preserve this issue as the local/no-cloud PostgreSQL requirement tracker, or explicitly fold it into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94675 as the canonical dual-backend database-abstraction design?
rationale: The codebase and repository policy are currently SQLite-only, while the requested PostgreSQL backend would require maintainer choices about storage policy, async execution, plugin SDK compatibility, migrations, credentials, and backup semantics.

options.title: Keep this local requirement open
options.body: Keep this issue open as user-demand evidence while the broader database-abstraction design decides the implementation path.

options.title: Fold into the abstraction tracker
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after maintainers update https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94675 to explicitly carry the local/no-cloud PostgreSQL requirement.

options.title: Reject alternate internal backends
options.body: Close as not planned if maintainers decide SQLite-only runtime storage remains the product boundary for OpenClaw-owned state.

recommendation.title: Keep this local requirement open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as user-demand evidence while the broader database-abstraction design decides the implementation path.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is already coordinating the adjacent session/transcript storage migration and explicitly reopened the broader database-abstraction issue as planned work.
